name: Repulsion Field
summary: It keeps an opposing permanent off the field for as long as it holds.

face.name: Repulsion Field

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Send an opposing permanent to the Abyss. As long as this card remains in play, that permanent stays in the Abyss. When this card leaves play, that permanent returns to play.

face.flavor: Space refuses to hold it. For now.
